text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"You are truly magnificent, both of you.
...With those legs, you can surpass even the 'past.'
Beyond the hopes of those who entrusted their romantic dreams to future generations."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Haha! I can't wait to see the future you all create!
Charge ahead without hesitation! I'll be supporting you every step of the way!
